# F5 Distributed Cloud Terraform Provider

> Provider: f5-sales-demo/xcsh | Registry: <https://registry.terraform.io/providers/f5-sales-demo/xcsh>

DEPRECATED — do not use: volterraedge/volterra

## Required Block

    terraform {
      required_providers {
        xcsh = {
          source = "f5-sales-demo/xcsh"
        }
      }
    }

## Syntax Rules

- OneOf selectors: use empty block `field {}`, never `field = true`
- Cross-resource refs: block with name + namespace attributes
- Boolean attributes: use `= true` / `= false`
- Fields marked "Server applies default when omitted" can be safely omitted

## Resource Categories

- [Load Balancing](_llms-txt/load-balancing.txt) (2 resources): HTTP/TCP/UDP/CDN load balancers, origin pools, health checks, and routing
- [Networking](_llms-txt/networking.txt) (2 resources): Virtual networks, BGP, cloud connectivity, tunnels, and network interfaces
- [Sites](_llms-txt/sites.txt) (2 resources): AWS/Azure/GCP VPC sites, SecureMesh, VoltStack, and site mesh groups
- [Authentication](_llms-txt/authentication.txt) (1 resources): Authentication methods, cloud credentials, and secret management
- [DNS](_llms-txt/dns.txt) (1 resources): DNS domains, zones, compliance checks, and DNS proxy configuration
- [Uncategorized](_llms-txt/uncategorized.txt) (1 resources): Resources pending categorization

## Data Sources

Read-only data sources for querying existing F5 XC objects across all resource categories.
